segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and it's the holiday season, Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫凯瑟琳，现在是假期季，马可。

segments.en: People are eating large meals with their families and I think oftentimes when you cook a lot of food, you have something extra at the end.
segments.zh: 人们和家人一起吃大餐，我认为当你做很多食物时，你最后会有一些额外的东西。

segments.en: What do we call that?
segments.zh: 我们怎么称呼它？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to talk about leftovers.
segments.zh: 今天我们来谈谈剩菜。

segments.en: That's the extra food after your meal that you eat later, maybe the next day.
segments.zh: 那是吃完饭剩下的食物，你过后才吃，也许是第二天。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, you know, during Christmas or during some holidays, we cook so much food that obviously we can't eat it all.
segments.zh: 所以，你知道，在圣诞节或一些假期期间，我们烹饪了这么多食物，显然我们不能把它全部吃掉。

segments.en: So we put it back in the refrigerator and then we eat it later.
segments.zh: 所以我们把它放回冰箱里，然后再吃。

segments.en: So those are called leftovers.
segments.zh: 所以这些被称为剩菜。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let's listen to this dialogue about leftovers and we'll be back in a moment to discuss what's happening in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听这个关于剩菜的对话，我们稍后会回来讨论对话中发生的事情。

segments.en: What's for dinner?
segments.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

segments.en: Leftovers.
segments.zh: 剩菜。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Leftovers of what and from when?
segments.zh: 什么剩菜？什么时候剩下的？

segments.en: From last night.
segments.zh: 昨天晚上的。

segments.en: I took the leftover turkey, mixed it with some diced peppers and onions, add a little bit of mayonnaise and made some sandwiches.
segments.zh: 我把剩火鸡肉和切丁的甜椒、洋葱拌在一起，加了点蛋黄酱，做成了三明治。

segments.en: Isn't that dangerous though?
segments.zh: 不过，这样吃不会有危险吗？

segments.en: I mean, bacteria and germs reproducing on food that was left out or reheated.
segments.zh: 我是说，放在外面或反复加热的食物可能会滋生细菌。

segments.en: Well, I didn't leave the turkey out at room temperature for more than an hour and I refrigerated soon after we finished eating.
segments.zh: 火鸡在室温下放了不到一小时，我们吃完饭很快就放进冰箱了。

segments.en: Also when reheating, I put it in the oven for 15 minutes at 100 degrees Celsius.
segments.zh: 重新加热时，我还用摄氏一百度的烤箱烤了十五分钟。

segments.en: Well, okay.
segments.zh: 嗯，好吧。

segments.en: I'm just afraid of getting food poisoning.
segments.zh: 我只是怕吃坏肚子。

segments.en: Don't worry about it.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: Making a new meal out of leftovers is almost an art.
segments.zh: 用剩菜做出一道新菜，简直是一门艺术。

segments.en: Not only do you save money, but you also get to be creative and have something different to eat.
segments.zh: 既省钱，又能发挥创意，还能换换口味。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of vocab there.
segments.zh: 所以那里有很多词汇。

segments.en: Let's take a look at it in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 让我们在语言要点中看看它。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So Marco, there's one cooking term really in this dialogue that is, it's a little bit different from the others.
segments.zh: 所以马可，这个对话里有一个烹饪术语，和其他的有点不一样。

segments.en: So let's start with that.
segments.zh: 所以让我们开始吧。

segments.en: It's diced.
segments.zh: 是 diced，也就是切成丁。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We were talking about taking some peppers or diced peppers.
segments.zh: 我们说的是放一些甜椒，也就是甜椒丁。

segments.en: So when you dice a vegetable or anything that you're cooking, basically you're making little pieces, little squares almost.
segments.zh: 因此，当您将蔬菜或烹饪的任何东西切成丁时，基本上您是在切成小块，几乎是小方块。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you can cut something many different ways.
segments.zh: 所以你可以用很多不同的方式切东西。

segments.en: You can cut big pieces and small pieces, but diced peppers, diced is a specific way to cut something in small, like you say, small squares.
segments.zh: 你可以切成大块或小块，但“辣椒切丁”是一种特定的切法，切成像你说的那种小方块。

segments.en: And so in recipes, you will often see this instruction, dice the peppers, or in this case, the peppers are diced.
segments.zh: 所以在食谱中，你经常会看到这个说明，把辣椒切成丁，或者在这种情况下，辣椒被切成丁。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we took some turkey, mix it with diced peppers and a lot of things.
segments.zh: 所以我们拿了一些火鸡，把它和很多东西混合在一起。

segments.en: And the roommate was a little bit concerned about bacteria and germs.
segments.zh: 室友有点担心细菌和病菌。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So bacteria and germs, these sound like very scientific words.
segments.zh: 所以细菌和病菌，这些听起来像是非常科学的词。

segments.en: Bacteria is something that grows on, well, everything really.
segments.zh: 细菌这种生物，嗯，其实什么东西上都会长。

segments.en: But if you leave food out, for example, it gets bacteria or germs are things that can make you sick.
segments.zh: 例如，如果你把食物放在外面，它就会滋生细菌；病菌是会让你生病的东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we need to avoid these things in the kitchen because they make us unhealthy.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要在厨房里避免这些东西，因为它们让我们不健康。

segments.en: And that's why we wash our hands and things like that.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们洗手之类的东西。

segments.en: But when you have food that's left out, the risk is what, Marco?
segments.zh: 但是当你的食物放在外面时，风险是什么，马可？

segments.en: Is that you get bacteria or germs on it.
segments.zh: 就是食物上会沾上细菌和病菌。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's dangerous, especially with meat.
segments.zh: 所以这很危险，尤其是肉类。

segments.en: If you leave it out, it's very, very dangerous because you can get some bacteria that will make you sick.
segments.zh: 如果你把它放在外面，那非常非常危险，因为可能会滋生让你生病的细菌。

segments.en: And the reason why we're a little bit concerned, especially with meats, is if you leave it out after cooking it at room temperature.
segments.zh: 我们之所以有点担心，尤其是肉类，是因为你煮熟后把它放在室温下。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So room temperature is the temperature of a normal room.
segments.zh: 所以室温是正常房间的温度。

segments.en: Maybe it's 65 degrees or what's 25 degrees Celsius.
segments.zh: 也许是 65 度或 25 摄氏度。

segments.en: It's the temperature of the inside of a room.
segments.zh: 这是房间内部的温度。

segments.en: And so it's not cold, it's not hot, it's just normal.
segments.zh: 所以它不冷，不热，这很正常。

segments.en: And when we leave food out, especially meat, like you're saying, we have to be careful.
segments.zh: 当我们把食物放在外面时，尤其是肉类，就像你说的那样，我们必须小心。

segments.en: You can't leave it out for very long if it's something like eggs or milk or what we call perishables.
segments.zh: 像鸡蛋、牛奶，或者我们所说的易腐食品，都不能在外面放太久。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So actually, here comes the other two words that are a little bit of a contrast.
segments.zh: 所以实际上，这里出现了另外两个有点对比的词。

segments.en: We're going to talk about food that is reheated or refrigerated.
segments.zh: 我们将讨论重新加热或冷藏的食物。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the roommate is explaining, don't worry, we have done these things to this food so it's safe.
segments.zh: 所以室友在解释，别担心，我们对这种食物做了这些事情，所以它是安全的。

segments.en: So one thing you can do to food to make it safe to kill germs is to reheat it.
segments.zh: 所以让食物变安全、杀死细菌的一个办法，就是重新加热它。

segments.en: That means, well, you know the word heated, right?
segments.zh: 这意味着，嗯，你知道加热这个词，对吧？

segments.en: It's to make something hot.
segments.zh: 这是为了做一些热的东西。

segments.en: How is that different from reheated?
segments.zh: 这与重新加热有何不同？

segments.en: Well, because you cooked it already, so it was warm.
segments.zh: 好吧，因为你已经煮熟了，所以很热。

segments.en: Now it went a little bit cold because it's at room temperature.
segments.zh: 现在它有点冷，因为它在室温下。

segments.en: So in order to make sure that it's safe to eat and you kill that bacteria, you reheat it so you kind of cook it again a little bit.
segments.zh: 所以为了确保它可以安全地食用并杀死那些细菌，你重新加热它，这样你就可以再次煮一下。

segments.en: Yeah, you cook it again.
segments.zh: 是的，你又煮了。

segments.en: So with leftovers, we often have to reheat things because they were hot, then they were cold and now we want them hot again.
segments.zh: 所以对于剩菜，我们经常不得不重新加热东西，因为它们很热，然后它们很冷，现在我们希望它们再次变热。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we reheat them.
segments.zh: 所以我们重新加热它们。

segments.en: The opposite of that would be refrigerate.
segments.zh: 与之相反的是冷藏。

segments.en: Right, and this is what you should do.
segments.zh: 是的，这是你应该做的。

segments.en: If you take something and put it in the refrigerator, what you are doing, the verb, the action is to refrigerate it.
segments.zh: 如果你拿东西放在冰箱里，你在做什么，动词，动作就是把它冷藏起来。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So to refrigerate something means to make it cold.
segments.zh: 所以冷藏东西意味着让它变冷。

segments.en: You know, there are important things that we refrigerate.
segments.zh: 你知道，我们冷藏的一些重要的东西。

segments.en: We refrigerate eggs, we refrigerate milk, we refrigerate butter.
segments.zh: 我们冷藏鸡蛋，冷藏牛奶，冷藏黄油。

segments.en: These are things that can make us sick if we don't make them cold.
segments.zh: 如果我们不让它们变冷，这些东西会让我们感到恶心。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So those are the two words.
segments.zh: 所以这两个词。

segments.en: Now obviously, it's a little bit different because the prefix to reheat means to do it again while to refrigerate means you're just making it cold.
segments.zh: 很明显，这两个词有点不同，因为 reheat 的前缀 re- 表示“再来一次”，而 refrigerate 只是表示让它变冷。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well, they're important terms and again, we also have the adjectives.
segments.zh: 好吧，它们是重要的术语，我们也有形容词。

segments.en: This is reheated or refrigerated.
segments.zh: 这是再加热或冷藏。

segments.en: But there are another couple of phrases that are really important so let's take a listen to those in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 但是还有另外几个短语非常重要，所以让我们听听流利表达中的那些。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: All right, so the first phrase we're going to take a look at is when one of the roommates says, hey, what's for dinner?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们要看的第一个短语是当其中一个室友说，嘿，晚餐吃什么？

segments.en: What's for dinner?
segments.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

segments.en: All right, this is a very, very standard phrase.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个非常非常标准的短语。

segments.en: This is something you'll hear at home, you'll hear with your friends.
segments.zh: 这是你在家里听到的，你会和你的朋友一起听到的。

segments.en: It's usually something we say that when someone is cooking food for dinner.
segments.zh: 当有人为晚餐做饭时，我们通常会说这句话。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We're asking what are we going to eat for dinner?
segments.zh: 我们在问晚餐要吃什么？

segments.en: Mom, what's for dinner?
segments.zh: 妈妈，晚餐吃什么？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: I used to say that every single day when I came home from school.
segments.zh: 我以前每天放学回家都会这么说。

segments.en: Well, obviously, you don't want to say the long phrase.
segments.zh: 好吧，很明显，你不想说长语。

segments.en: What are we going to have for dinner tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚晚餐要吃什么？

segments.en: So you just say, what's for dinner?
segments.zh: 所以你只是说，晚餐吃什么？

segments.en: What's for dinner?
segments.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

segments.en: And then the answer would be lasagna or turkey sandwiches.
segments.zh: 然后答案是千层面或火鸡三明治。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: Now when they started talking about the leftover turkey, he was a little bit concerned as we said about bacteria and germs because it usually happens that you get this on food that was left out.
segments.zh: 现在，当他们开始谈论剩下的火鸡时，他有点担心我们说的细菌和病菌，因为这通常发生在放在外面的食物上。

segments.en: All right, so the verb here is to leave out, to leave something out.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这里的动词是 leave out，把某样东西放在外面。

segments.en: It means to leave something or put something at room temperature.
segments.zh: 意思就是把某样东西放在室温下。

segments.en: So Marco, you and I are eating turkey, it's Thanksgiving, and we start to have coffee and dessert and the turkey is still in the room, at room temperature.
segments.zh: 所以马可，你和我在吃火鸡，今天是感恩节，我们开始喝咖啡和甜点，火鸡还在房间里，室温下。

segments.en: We did not refrigerate it.
segments.zh: 我们没有冷藏它。

segments.en: That means it was left out.
segments.zh: 这意味着它被放在外面了。

segments.en: How long was it left out?
segments.zh: 它放在外面多长时间了？

segments.en: Well, maybe two hours.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许两个小时。

segments.en: That means so it's not in a refrigerator.
segments.zh: 这意味着它不在冰箱中。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That's exactly what it means.
segments.zh: 这正是它的含义。

segments.en: So maybe you go to sleep and you left the turkey out.
segments.zh: 所以也许你去睡觉，你把火鸡放在外面。

segments.en: It's still on the table maybe at room temperature.
segments.zh: 它可能在室温下仍在桌子上。

segments.en: Oh no, we can't eat it if we left it out for like 12 hours.
segments.zh: 哦，不，如果把它放在外面 12 小时，我们就不能吃了。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right, so it's not good to leave food out.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以把食物放在外面是不好的。

segments.en: And now what happens is if you do eat food that was left out for too long, you could get food poisoning.
segments.zh: 现在的情况是，如果你吃的食物放在外面太久，你可能会出现食物中毒。

segments.en: Now this is very serious and it's something that you should be very careful about when you're cooking.
segments.zh: 现在这是非常严重的，这是您在烹饪时应该非常小心的事情。

segments.en: Food poisoning is getting sick from your food.
segments.zh: 食物中毒就是因为吃了食物而生病。

segments.en: There are different kinds of food poisoning, but usually it makes you throw up, it makes your stomach hurt, it's quite painful.
segments.zh: 有不同种类的食物中毒，但通常它会让你呕吐，它让你的胃痛，很痛苦。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And this is why we say you should wash your hands before you cook.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们说你应该在你做饭之前洗手。

segments.en: You should make sure that you refrigerate meat because you want to avoid food poisoning.
segments.zh: 你应该确保冷藏肉，因为你想避免食物中毒。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And it comes from the noun poison, a poison, which is something that is harmful for your body.
segments.zh: 它来自名词毒药，一种对身体有害的毒药。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: There are many different kinds of poison, but food poisoning means becoming sick, your body getting sick after you eat something bad.
segments.zh: 有许多不同的毒药，但食物中毒意味着生病，你吃了一些坏东西后你的身体就会生病。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So with all this stuff here, we can review everything one last time.
segments.zh: 所以，讲了这么多，我们最后再复习一遍。

segments.en: What's for dinner?
segments.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

segments.en: Leftovers.
segments.zh: 剩菜。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Leftovers of what and from when?
segments.zh: 什么剩菜？什么时候剩下的？

segments.en: From last night.
segments.zh: 昨天晚上的。

segments.en: I took the leftover turkey, mixed it with some diced peppers and onions, add a little bit of mayonnaise and made some sandwiches.
segments.zh: 我把剩火鸡肉和切丁的甜椒、洋葱拌在一起，加了点蛋黄酱，做成了三明治。

segments.en: Isn't that dangerous though?
segments.zh: 不过，这样吃不会有危险吗？

segments.en: I mean, bacteria and germs reproducing on food that was left out or reheated.
segments.zh: 我是说，放在外面或反复加热的食物可能会滋生细菌。

segments.en: Well I didn't leave the turkey at a room temperature for more than an hour and I refrigerated soon after we finished eating.
segments.zh: 好吧，火鸡放在室温下没超过一小时，我们吃完就马上冷藏了。

segments.en: Also when reheating, I put it in the oven for 15 minutes at 100 degrees Celsius.
segments.zh: 重新加热时，我还用摄氏一百度的烤箱烤了十五分钟。

segments.en: Well, okay.
segments.zh: 嗯，好吧。

segments.en: I'm just afraid of getting food poisoning.
segments.zh: 我只是怕吃坏肚子。

segments.en: Don't worry about it.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: Making a new meal out of leftovers is almost an art.
segments.zh: 用剩菜做出一道新菜，简直是一门艺术。

segments.en: Not only do you save money, but you also get to be creative and have something different to eat.
segments.zh: 既省钱，又能发挥创意，还能换换口味。

segments.en: All right, so this is actually good advice about leftovers, about having something to eat.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这实际上是关于剩菜和吃东西的好建议。

segments.en: But at the same time, I don't know how many people actually are very careful with these things.
segments.zh: 但与此同时，我不知道有多少人对这些事情实际上非常小心。

segments.en: For example, pizza.
segments.zh: 比如披萨。

segments.en: Sometimes you leave pizza out on the table all night and the next morning you have some pizza.
segments.zh: 有时你整晚都把披萨放在桌子上，第二天早上你会吃一些披萨。

segments.en: I always refrigerate my pizza.
segments.zh: 我总是冷藏我的披萨。

segments.en: I know people who leave their pizza out and then eat it, but there's cheese and sausage and you want to refrigerate that stuff.
segments.zh: 我认识一些人，他们把披萨放在外面然后吃掉，但有奶酪和香肠，你想冷藏这些东西。

segments.en: So I always wrap it in plastic and put it on a plate in the fridge.
segments.zh: 所以我总是用塑料包起来，放在冰箱里的盘子上。

segments.en: Oh, okay.
segments.zh: 哦，好吧。

segments.en: You wrap it in plastic.
segments.zh: 你用塑料包起来。

segments.en: Well, because in the refrigerator there's also germs, so you need to make sure you cover your food.
segments.zh: 好吧，因为在冰箱里也有细菌，所以你需要确保覆盖你的食物。

segments.en: Right, right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对，对。

segments.en: What about, have you ever had a bad case of food poisoning because of having leftovers?
segments.zh: 怎么样，你有没有因为吃剩菜而患过严重的食物中毒？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: I've had food poisoning, but not because of leftovers.
segments.zh: 我有食物中毒，但不是因为剩菜。

segments.en: Because as I said before, I wrap things, I put them in the refrigerator.
segments.zh: 因为正如我之前所说，我把东西包起来，我把它们放在冰箱里。

segments.en: I'm very careful because I don't want to get sick or I don't want to get other people sick.
segments.zh: 我非常小心，因为我不想生病或不想让其他人生病。

segments.en: But Thanksgiving or Christmas, you have to give food to many other people.
segments.zh: 但是感恩节或圣诞节，你必须给许多其他人提供食物。

segments.en: I don't want to make anyone sick.
segments.zh: 我不想让任何人生病。

segments.en: And actually, you can get food poisoning not only from leftovers, but from maybe food that maybe was expired.
segments.zh: 实际上，食物中毒不只是吃剩菜会得，吃了可能过期的食物也会得。

segments.en: Sometimes cheese maybe can be expired, you didn't realize it, and you get food poisoning.
segments.zh: 有时奶酪可能会过期，你没有意识到，你会中毒。

segments.en: Or from people who are cooking with things that are not clean.
segments.zh: 或者来自用不干净的东西做饭的人。

segments.en: So you have something that's not clean or food that's not fresh and it makes you very sick.
segments.zh: 所以你有一些不干净的东西或不新鲜的食物，它让你病得很重。

segments.en: So it's not good for your health.
segments.zh: 所以这对你的健康不利。

segments.en: So you have to be careful.
segments.zh: 所以你必须小心。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's an interesting thing, especially with, like I said, so many holidays where you cook so much food that people have a lot of leftovers.
segments.zh: 所以这挺有意思，尤其像我说的，有那么多节日，你会做很多菜，所以人们有很多剩菜。

segments.en: And not only that, but even at restaurants, maybe you order too much, so you have leftovers you want to take home to your dog or to have later.
segments.zh: 不仅如此，就算在餐馆，你也可能点太多，于是有剩菜要带回家喂狗或以后再吃。

segments.en: I love leftovers.
segments.zh: 我喜欢剩菜。

segments.en: Let us know, do you have leftovers in your country?
segments.zh: 让我们知道，你的国家有剩菜吗？

segments.en: Are there things that you should and shouldn't do when cooking?
segments.zh: 做饭时有什么应该和不应该做的事情吗？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right, we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 好，到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye for now.
segments.zh: 现在再见。
